verdict.rationale: Gusto's API exposes payroll preview/calculation-adjacent data (e.g., GET /v1/companies/{id}/payrolls, contractor payment preview endpoint, submission_blockers) and offers MCP servers (dev-assistant MCP for building integrations, and a remote MCP server for accessing account data via natural language) that an agent could use to pull payroll run data programmatically. However, there is no documented dedicated 'payroll preview' endpoint with anomaly detection, no evidence of a structured anomaly-flagging/review mechanism, and no documented approval workflow gating agent-run previews before submission. missing for 10: a dedicated payroll-preview API returning calculated totals for review, built-in anomaly/variance detection logic, and a documented approve/reject workflow tied to agent-surfaced anomalies.
